framework_lessons: Separate cyclical, structural and sovereign horizons.
assessment: The clearest successful forecasts are Bitcoin’s new high before end-2025 and Southwestern’s acquisition. The adopted late-2023 rate-cut expectation and stagflationary recession base case fail. The author now explicitly identifies the bill/RRP exception that would invalidate the QE-necessity narrative, an important improvement. Producer balance-sheet analysis is stronger than the rigid macro cycle timing.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
